findings: SDK 1.7.0 retained smoothquant_coefficient=0.3 in the effective compile configuration.
The generated quantized_model.pt was byte-identical to raw-output-minmax, so the candidate failed before simulator screening.

config.goal: Reduce Axelera raw-output YOLO26n INT8 confidence error with SmoothQuant cross-layer equalization.
config.scope: One-variable SDK 1.7.0 host quantization experiment; no simulator metric interpretation after artifact no-op; no AIPU execution.
config.verify: Require effective smoothquant_coefficient=0.3 and a quantized-model SHA different from raw-output-minmax before the frozen simulator screen.

interpretation: SmoothQuant 0.3 is accepted by the configuration layer but produces no serialized quantized-model change for this raw graph and SDK path. The candidate is discarded without spending a redundant simulator screen.
non_claim: This phase contains no Metis AIPU compile, execution, quality, latency, stability, or deployment result.
